section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Intuitive Eating Scale-2 (IES-2), a 23-item instrument used to assess participants' intuitive eating behaviors in relation to satiety signals and cravings versus dietary rules. Participants completed the IES-2 daily, rating items on a 1-5 scale, with Cronbach's alphas ranging from .87 to .90 across days and average intuitive eating scores of 3.48 (SD = 0.48) over the week. This is a methods/instruments section that does not provide study-level demographic or outcome data.
